definitions.gloss: outbreak of war; start of hostilities; commencement of battle
definitions.explanation: The beginning of armed conflict or war. Refers to the moment fighting officially starts between nations or forces.

examples.japanese: {開戦|かいせん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{知|し}らせ→知らせ：03252_shirase⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}いた→届く：00899_todoku⟧。
examples.english: News of the outbreak of war arrived.

examples.japanese: ⟦{外交|がいこう}→外交：02627_gaikou⟧⟦{交渉|こうしょう}→交渉：02727_koushou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決裂|けつれつ}→決裂：14895_ketsuretsu⟧し、{開戦|かいせん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{至|いた}った→至る：02009_itaru⟧。
examples.english: Diplomatic negotiations broke down and led to the outbreak of war.

examples.japanese: {開戦|かいせん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{七十年|ななじゅうねん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{経|た}った→経つ：09892_tatsu⟧⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{戦争|せんそう}→戦争：01450_sensou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{記憶|きおく}→記憶：00234_kioku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{人々|ひとびと}→人々：03141_hitobito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{残|のこ}っている→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: Even seventy years after the war began, memories of the conflict remain in people's hearts.

notes:
A compound of {開|かい} (to open, to start) and ⟦{戦|せん}→〜戦：28346_sen⟧ (war, battle).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {開戦|かいせん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{踏|ふ}み{切|き}る→踏み切る：06237_fumikiru⟧ (to decide to go to war)
- {開戦|かいせん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{至|いた}る→至る：02009_itaru⟧ (to lead to war)
- {開戦|かいせん}⟦{直前|ちょくぜん}→直前：13651_chokuzen⟧ (just before the outbreak of war)
- {開戦|かいせん}⟦{当初|とうしょ}→当初：12503_tousho⟧ (at the start of the war)
- {開戦|かいせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{回避|かいひ}する→回避する：17014_kaihisuru⟧ (to avoid war)

The antonym is ⟦{終戦|しゅうせん}→終戦：18973_shuusen⟧ (end of war). Related terms include {宣戦|せんせん} (declaration of war) and ⟦{休戦|きゅうせん}→休戦：14815_kyuusen⟧ (ceasefire).
